name: RLSC Screen Analysis and Perspective Packages
description: Split RLSC screen inspection into @qa-sdk/rlsc-analysis and @qa-sdk/rlsc-perspective while preserving rlsc compatibility and migrating rlsc-demo to consume the new packages.

userStories.title: Create Analysis Package Skeleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a dedicated @qa-sdk/rlsc-analysis package so that screen scanning and layout analysis can be used independently of visualization.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TypeScript and tsup configuration consistent with existing package patterns
Export a public package entry point from packages/rlsc-analysis/src/index.ts
Package does not depend on Three.js or visual rendering libraries

userStories.title: Move Core Types and Analysis APIs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want @qa-sdk/rlsc-analysis to own the screen document model and analysis APIs so that analysis has a single source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: @qa-sdk/rlsc-analysis exports RLSCDocument, RLSCNode, LayoutRect, and related analysis types
Existing unit tests for area analysis are available under the analysis package
Analysis APIs can be imported without importing browser DOM collector or Three.js

userStories.title: Add Metadata Annotation Helpers
userStories.description: As an application developer, I want helpers for writing screen metadata into DOM elements so that components can be consistently identified before collection.
acceptanceCriteria: Export metadata attribute constants for data-qa-address, data-component-id, data-debug-label, and data-boundary
Export createMetadataAttributes() for frameworks or template code that need plain attribute objects
Export annotateElement() for applying metadata to an existing DOM element
Annotation helpers do not require DOM collection or perspective viewer imports

userStories.title: Add Metadata and Identifier Extraction
userStories.description: As a debugging user, I want DOM elements to expose stable identifiers so that I can identify and copy the component or screen region I selected.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce fallback CSS selector when metadata is missing
Preferred identifier order is componentId, then qaAddress, then cssSelector, then nodeId

userStories.title: Move Browser Collection APIs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the analysis package to collect browser DOM metadata so that it can produce screen documents from live pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser collector preserves data-qa-address and data-component-id
Browser collector attaches generated identifiers to collected nodes
Monitor APIs continue to support text-aware DOM change tracking
Browser APIs remain separate from pure analysis imports

userStories.title: Create Perspective Package Skeleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a dedicated @qa-sdk/rlsc-perspective package so that 3D screen visualization can be reused outside the demo.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TypeScript and tsup configuration consistent with existing package patterns
Add three as a normal dependency
Export createPerspectiveViewer from the package entry point
Package public API accepts RLSCDocument and optional issue data as inputs
Package does not export DOM scanner or collector APIs

userStories.title: Move Perspective Viewer Implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the reusable 3D viewer to live in @qa-sdk/rlsc-perspective so that demo code does not own library functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer exposes update(doc) and dispose() lifecycle methods
Viewer supports renderer: auto, webgl, and canvas
Canvas renderer is used when WebGL is unavailable or explicitly selected
Viewer implementation does not call querySelector, getBoundingClientRect, or DOM collector APIs for screen scanning
Verify in browser with screenshot or pixel check
Confirm hover/select/copy interactions work in the browser

userStories.title: Add Grouping, Hover, and Selection Model
userStories.description: As a debugging user, I want to choose the grouping level and select visual layers so that I can inspect the right component boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer supports groupBy values: dom-node, componentId, qaAddress, and role
Hover highlights only the hovered layer
Non-hovered layers visually recede while hover is active
Click selects a layer and keeps it selected
Selection exposes node id, component id, qa address, role, text hint, and preferred identifier when available
Verify in browser with screenshot or pixel check
Confirm hover/select/copy interactions work in the browser

userStories.title: Add Copy and Debug Issue Visualization
userStories.description: As a debugging user, I want to copy selected identifiers and see layout issues in context so that I can feed precise debugging information back into tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Perspective package exposes selected identifier data without requiring demo internals
Copy format defaults to plain identifier
Optional JSON copy payload can include identifier and issue details
Viewer accepts containment leak issues from analysis results
Viewer accepts text overflow issues when text analysis data is available
Layers with issues are visually marked
Verify in browser with screenshot or pixel check
Confirm hover/select/copy interactions work in the browser

userStories.title: Preserve Existing RLSC Compatibility
userStories.description: As an existing user, I want rlsc imports to keep working so that this split does not break current consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing rlsc import path continues to work
Existing rlsc/analysis, rlsc/browser, and rlsc/rendering exports continue to work
rlsc re-exports selected APIs from new packages where appropriate
Existing pnpm --filter rlsc test remains passing
Existing README documents the compatibility position

userStories.title: Migrate RLSC Demo to New Packages
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want rlsc-demo to consume the new packages so that the demo proves the package split works.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo imports pure analysis APIs from @qa-sdk/rlsc-analysis
Demo imports browser collection APIs from @qa-sdk/rlsc-analysis/browser
Demo imports perspective viewer APIs from @qa-sdk/rlsc-perspective
Demo no longer owns reusable perspective renderer logic
Demo still supports Run, Mutate DOM, and Start Monitor
Demo shows selected identifier and copy button
Demo shows containment leak issue details when selecting affected layers
Verify in browser with screenshot or pixel check
Confirm hover/select/copy interactions work in the browser

userStories.title: Document Package Boundaries and Usage
userStories.description: As a developer, I want clear package documentation so that I can use analysis and visualization independently.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/rlsc-analysis/README.md explains collection, metadata annotation, identifiers, and analysis
packages/rlsc-perspective/README.md explains viewer setup, lifecycle, grouping, hover/select, and copy workflow
Example code shows metadata annotation usage
Example code shows analysis plus perspective visualization usage
Documentation states that @qa-sdk/rlsc-perspective does not scan DOM directly
